
		<h2>
			<a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiangji/p/23151568" title="发布于 2026-09-29 08:58">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">C#.NET源生成器命名规则</span>
    

</a>

		</h2>
		<div class="postText">    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        源生成器经常需要处理繁琐的命名及冲突问题
为此开发了独立的命名规则组件
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="一-前言">一、 前言</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>本文讲解在C#.NET源生成器中生成类的字段、属性、方法及参数和变量标识符的命名处理方式</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="二-c-命名规则">二、 C# 命名规则</h2>
<h3 id="1-camelcase小驼峰">1. CamelCase(小驼峰)‌</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>首字母小写,后续单词首字母大写</li>
<li>参数和变量适用</li>
<li>私有字段使用下划线 + 小驼峰</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-pascalcase-帕斯卡大驼峰">2. PascalCase (帕斯卡、大驼峰)‌</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>首字母大写,后续单词首字母大写</li>
<li>适用属性、方法及公开字段</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="3-开源项目handnaming用于命名">3. 开源项目Hand.Naming用于命名</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>dotnet add package Hand.Naming --version 0.3.2.1-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h4 id="31-camelwordrule-组件">3.1 CamelWordRule 组件</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>CamelWordRule.FistToLower处理小驼峰</li>
<li>可以把大驼峰转化为小驼峰</li>
<li>可以把下划线 + 小驼峰转化为小驼峰</li>
<li>本身就是小驼峰的不受影响</li>
<li>适用把属性名、字段名转化为参数名或变量名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Theory]
[InlineData("Test", "test")]
[InlineData("_id", "id")]
[InlineData("name", "name")]
public void FistToLower(string original, string expected)
{
    var result = CamelWordRule.FistToLower(original!);
    Assert.Equal(expected, result);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="32-underwordrule-组件">3.2 UnderWordRule 组件</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>UnderWordRule.UnderLower处理下划线 + 小驼峰</li>
<li>可以把大、小驼峰转化为下划线 + 小驼峰</li>
<li>本身就是下划线 + 小驼峰的不受影响</li>
<li>适用把参数名、属性名及公开字段名转化为私有字段名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Theory]
[InlineData("Test", "_test")]
[InlineData("test", "_test")]
[InlineData("_test", "_test")]
[InlineData("_Test", "_test")]
public void UnderLower(string original, string expected)
{
    var result = UnderWordRule.UnderLower(original!);
    Assert.Equal(expected, result);
}
</code></pre>
<h4 id="33-pascalwordrule-组件">3.3 PascalWordRule 组件</h4>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>PascalWordRule.FistToUpper处理大驼峰</li>
<li>可以下划线 + 小驼峰及小驼峰转化转化为大驼峰</li>
<li>本身就是大驼峰的不受影响</li>
<li>适用把参数名和私有字段名转化为属性和公开字段名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">[Theory]
[InlineData("test", "Test")]
[InlineData("_id", "Id")]
[InlineData("Name", "Name")]
public void FistToUpper(string original, string expected)
{
    var result = PascalWordRule.FistToUpper(original!);
    Assert.Equal(expected, result);
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="三-开源项目handgeneratorsnaming处理成员名冲突">三、 开源项目Hand.Generators.Naming处理成员名冲突</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>dotnet add package Hand.Generators.Naming --version 0.3.0-alpha</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-按user生成userdto的case">1. 按User生成UserDto的Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>其中 UserDto 中已经存在Id属性了</li>
<li>通过 Hand.Naming.KindContainer 组件处理命名冲突</li>
<li>通过 Contains 方法判断是否含同名成员</li>
<li>通过 AddKind 方法添加新属性</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"
    public partial class UserDto
    {
        public string? Id { get; set; }
    }
    public record User(int Id, string Name);
    ";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
SyntaxTree syntaxTree = driver.Parse(source);
var destType = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var compilation = driver.Compile(syntaxTree);
var sourceSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var destSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("UserDto");
Assert.NotNull(destSymbol);
var nameProvider = KindContainer.Create(destSymbol);
var sourceProperties = SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase(sourceSymbol).ToArray();

var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(destType);
foreach (var sourceProperty in sourceProperties)
{
    var propertyName = sourceProperty.Name;
    if (nameProvider.Contains(propertyName))
        continue;
    var property = sourceProperty.Type.ToSyntax().GetSetProperty(propertyName).Public();
    generator.AddProperty(property);
    nameProvider.AddKind(propertyName, MemberKind.PropertyDeclaration);
}
var code = generator.Build().NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("Name", code);
Assert.DoesNotContain("Id", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-userdto生成代码如下">2. UserDto生成代码如下</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserDto
{
    public string Name { get; set; }
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="3-kindcontainer-主要方法">3. KindContainer 主要方法</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">class KindContainer
{
    bool Contains(string name);
    bool TryGetMemberKind(string name, out MemberKind kind);
    void AddKind(string name, MemberKind kind);
}
</code></pre>
<h3 id="4-kindcontainer-调试结果">4. KindContainer 调试结果</h3>
<blockquote>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/248830/202609/248830-20260929085226460-328461110.png" alt="KindContainer" loading="lazy"></p>
</blockquote>
<h2 id="四-成员不能与类同名">四、 成员不能与类同名</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>除构造函数外,成员不能与当前类同名</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-使用-typedprovider-组件处理类名冲突">1. 使用 TypedProvider 组件处理类名冲突</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>TypedProvider 可以实现与 KindContainer 类似的功能</li>
<li>TypedProvider 会过滤当前类名</li>
<li>扩展方法 TryDeclareField,封装了 Contains 和 AddKind</li>
<li>TryDeclareProperty 也是扩展方法,用于属性的尝试添加</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"
    public partial class B;
    public record A(string Name, string B);
    ";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
SyntaxTree syntaxTree = driver.Parse(source);
var destType = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var compilation = driver.Compile(syntaxTree);
var sourceSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("A");
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var destSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("B");
Assert.NotNull(destSymbol);
var nameProvider = TypedProvider.Create(destSymbol);
var sourceProperties = SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase(sourceSymbol).ToArray();

var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(destType);
foreach (var sourceProperty in sourceProperties)
{
    var propertyName = sourceProperty.Name;
    if (nameProvider.TryDeclareField(propertyName))
    {
        var field = sourceProperty.Type.ToSyntax()
            .Field(propertyName, SyntaxGenerator.DefaultLiteral.SuppressNull())
            .Public();
        generator.AddField(field);
    }
}
var code = generator.Build().NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("Name", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-示例1生成如下代码">2. 示例1生成如下代码</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>由于类A的属性B与类B重名被 TypedProvider 过滤掉了</li>
<li>如果示例2.1换成 KindContainer 生成的代码可能就编译不过了(CS0542)</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class B
{
    public string Name = default!;
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="五方法支持重载">五、方法支持重载</h2>
<h3 id="1-methodcontainer-组件支持处理重载">1. MethodContainer 组件支持处理重载</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过 TryDeclareMethod 尝试添加方法签名</li>
<li>虽然已经存在Add方法, 但新添加的Add方法参数类型不同,可以添加成功</li>
<li>MethodContainer 通过匹配参数个数、类型及顺序实现重载逻辑判断</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"
    public partial class Calculator
    {
        public static int Add(int a, int b) =&gt; a + b;
    }
    ";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
SyntaxTree syntaxTree = driver.Parse(source);
var destType = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var compilation = driver.Compile(syntaxTree);
var destSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("Calculator");
Assert.NotNull(destSymbol);
var nameContainer = MethodContainer.Create(destSymbol);
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(destType);
var methodName = "Add";
Assert.True(nameContainer.Contains(methodName));
var methodSymbol = compilation.GetDecimalSymbol();
INamedTypeSymbol[] parameterSymbols = [methodSymbol, methodSymbol];
if (nameContainer.TryDeclareMethod(methodName, parameterSymbols))
{
    var methodType = methodSymbol.ToSyntax();
    var a = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("a");
    var b = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("b");
    var method = methodType.Method(methodName, [methodType.Parameter(a.Identifier), methodType.Parameter(b.Identifier)])
        .ToBuilder()
        .Return(a.Add(b))
        .Public()
        .Static();
    generator.AddMethod(method);
}
var code = generator.Build().NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains(methodName, code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-示例1生成如下代码-1">2. 示例1生成如下代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class Calculator
{
    public static decimal Add(decimal a, decimal b)
    {
        return a + b;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="六-综合应用">六、 综合应用</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如何既支持字段、属性又支持方法重载</li>
<li>这就是 CompositeProvider 组件应用的场景</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-使用-compositeprovider-的-case">1. 使用 CompositeProvider 的 Case</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"
    public partial class B
    {
        public string? Id { get; set;}
        public void Deconstruct(out string? id)
        {
            id = Id;
        }
    }
    public record A(int? Id, string Name, string B);
    ";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
SyntaxTree syntaxTree = driver.Parse(source);
var destType = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().FirstOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var compilation = driver.Compile(syntaxTree);
var sourceSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("A");
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var destSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("B");
Assert.NotNull(destSymbol);
var nameProvider = CompositeProvider.Create(destSymbol);
var sourceProperties = SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase(sourceSymbol).ToArray();
var sourceCount = sourceProperties.Length;
var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(destType);

var parameterSymbol0 = compilation.GetNullable(compilation.GetStringSymbol());
var parameterSymbols = new List&lt;ITypeSymbol&gt;(sourceCount) { parameterSymbol0 };
var method = SyntaxGenerator.VoidType.Method("Deconstruct")
    .ToBuilder()
    .AddParameter(parameterSymbol0.ToSyntax().Parameter("id").Out())
    .AddExpression(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("id").Assign(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Id")));
foreach (var sourceProperty in sourceProperties)
{
    var propertyName = sourceProperty.Name;
    if (nameProvider.TryDeclareProperty(propertyName))
    {
        var propertySymbol = sourceProperty.Type;
        parameterSymbols.Add(propertySymbol);
        var property = propertySymbol.ToSyntax()
            .GetSetProperty(propertyName)
            .Public();
        generator.AddProperty(property);

        var parameter = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(CamelWordRule.FistToLower(propertyName));
        method.AddParameter(propertySymbol.ToSyntax().Parameter(parameter.Identifier).Out())
            .AddExpression(parameter.Assign(SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(propertyName)));
    }
}
if (nameProvider.TryDeclareMethod("Deconstruct", [.. parameterSymbols]))
    generator.AddMethod(method.End().Public());
var code = generator.Build().NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("Name", code);
Assert.Contains("Deconstruct", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-示例1生成如下代码-2">2. 示例1生成如下代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class B
{
    public string Name { get; set; }

    public void Deconstruct(out string? id, out string name)
    {
        id = Id;
        name = Name;
    }
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="七处理基类成员冲突">七、处理基类成员冲突</h2>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>可以添加 new 来解决与基类成员重名的问题</li>
<li>InheritProvider 组件可以处理这种问题</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="1-使用-inheritprovider-的-case">1. 使用 InheritProvider 的 Case</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>通过方法 TypedProvider.Inherit 构造 InheritProvider</li>
<li>通过 TryDeclareField 的 isNew 输出参数判断是否与基类重名</li>
<li>如果重名增加 new 修饰符</li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">var source = @"
    public record Column(string Name);
    public abstract class Table(string name)
    {
        public string Name { get; } = name;
        public abstract Column[] Columns { get; }
    }
    public record User(int Id, string Name);
    public partial class UserTable() : Table(""Users"");
";
var driver = SyntaxTreeDriver.CreateDefaultDriver();
SyntaxTree syntaxTree = driver.Parse(source);
var destType = syntaxTree.GetRoot().DescendantNodes().OfType&lt;ClassDeclarationSyntax&gt;().LastOrDefault();
Assert.NotNull(destType);
var compilation = driver.Compile(syntaxTree);
var sourceSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("User");
Assert.NotNull(sourceSymbol);
var destSymbol = compilation.GetTypeByMetadataName("UserTable");
Assert.NotNull(destSymbol);
var columnType = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName("Column");
InheritProvider nameProvider = TypedProvider.Inherit(destSymbol);
var sourceProperties = SymbolReflection.GetPublicPropertiesWithBase(sourceSymbol).ToArray();

var generator = SyntaxGenerator.Clone(destType);
var columnList = new List&lt;ExpressionSyntax&gt;();
foreach (var sourceProperty in sourceProperties)
{
    var columnName = sourceProperty.Name;
    if (nameProvider.TryDeclareField(columnName, out var isNew))
    {
        var column = SyntaxFactory.IdentifierName(columnName);
        var field = columnType
            .Field(column.Identifier, SyntaxGenerator.New([SyntaxGenerator.Literal(columnName)]))
            .Public();
        if (isNew)
            field = field.New();
        generator.AddField(field);
        columnList.Add(column);
    }
}
var columns = columnType.Array()
    .Property("Columns", SyntaxGenerator.Collection([.. columnList]))
    .Public()
    .Override();
generator.AddProperty(columns);

var code = generator.Build().NormalizeWhitespace().ToFullString();
Assert.Contains("new Column Name", code);
</code></pre>
<h3 id="2-示例1生成如下代码-3">2. 示例1生成如下代码</h3>
<pre><code class="language-csharp">partial class UserTable
{
    public Column Id = new("Id");
    public new Column Name = new("Name");
    public override Column[] Columns =&gt; [Id, Name];
}
</code></pre>
<h2 id="八最佳实践总结">八、最佳实践总结</h2>
<h3 id="1-使用-handnaming-规范化标识符命名">1. 使用 Hand.Naming 规范化标识符命名</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>CamelWordRule处理参数名或变量名</li>
<li>UnderWordRule处理私有字段名</li>
<li>PascalWordRule处理属性、方法、类及公开字段名</li>
<li>github仓库地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Naming" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Naming</a></li>
<li>gitee同步跟新仓库地址: <a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Naming" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/HandCore.net/tree/master/Hand.Naming</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
<h3 id="2-使用-handgeneratorsnaming-处理命名冲突">2. 使用 Hand.Generators.Naming 处理命名冲突</h3>
<blockquote>
<ul>
<li>如果需要定义新函数推荐使用 CompositeProvider 组件</li>
<li>如果只需要字段和属性推荐使用 TypedProvider 组件</li>
<li>如果涉及对基类成员名的重写,使用 Inherit</li>
<li>github仓库地址: <a href="https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators/tree/master/Hand.Generators.Naming" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://github.com/donetsoftwork/Hand.Generators/tree/master/Hand.Generators.Naming</a></li>
<li>gitee同步跟新仓库地址: <a href="https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators/tree/master/Hand.Generators.Naming" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://gitee.com/donetsoftwork/hand.-generators/tree/master/Hand.Generators.Naming</a></li>
</ul>
</blockquote>
